readme:
# ClaudeZH

**为 Claude 安卓版提供完整简体中文界面的 LSPosed 模块。**
**An LSPosed module that gives the Claude Android app a complete Simplified Chinese UI.**

作用域 / Scope: `com.anthropic.claude`

---

## 中文

Claude 安卓版没有中文界面，本模块在运行时把界面文案换成简体中文，
**不改动、不禁用应用的任何其他功能**，也不需要重打包 App。

聊天、语音、项目、连接器、设置、引导流程、错误提示等界面均已覆盖。

### 安装

1. 从 [Releases](../../releases) 下载 APK 并安装
2. 在 LSPosed 中启用模块
3. 勾选作用域 `com.anthropic.claude`
4. 强制停止并重新打开 Claude

模块本身没有界面，装好启用即可。

### 说明

- 产品与功能名保持英文：`Claude`、`Artifacts`、`Cowork`、`Dispatch`，
  套餐名 `Free` / `Pro` / `Max` / `Team` / `Enterprise` 同理。
- 服务端返回的内容不在替换范围内 —— 模型回复、连接器名称与描述、部分错误详情等
  都不是应用内置文案，无法本地翻译。

### 常见问题

**界面还是英文** —— 确认模块已在 LSPosed 中启用、作用域勾选了 Claude，然后**强制停止**
Claude 再打开（仅返回桌面不算重启）。

**更新 Claude 后出现部分英文** —— 新版本新增的文案还没翻译，等模块更新即可，其余部分不受影响。

**装不上 / 提示签名冲突** —— 说明设备上装过其他来源的同名模块，先卸载再安装。

### 下载与校验

模块以成品 APK 形式发布，只通过本仓库的 [Releases](../../releases) 分发。
每个版本的 APK 校验和写在对应的 Release 说明里，签名证书指纹固定为
`896153DB…34EDD64F`，指纹对不上的包不是本项目发布的。

---

## English

The Claude Android app has no Chinese UI — it falls back to English even when the system
language is Chinese. This module replaces the interface text with Simplified Chinese at
runtime. **No other functionality is changed or disabled**, and the app is never repackaged.

Chat, voice, projects, connectors, settings, onboarding and error messages are all covered.

### Install

1. Download the APK from [Releases](../../releases) and install it
2. Enable the module in LSPosed
3. Tick the scope `com.anthropic.claude`
4. Force-stop Claude and open it again

The module has no UI of its own.

### Notes

- Product and feature names stay in English: `Claude`, `Artifacts`, `Cowork`, `Dispatch`,
  and likewise the plan names `Free` / `Pro` / `Max` / `Team` / `Enterprise`.
- Server-delivered content is out of scope — model replies, connector names and
  descriptions, and some error details are not part of the app's own text.
- This release targets Claude `1.260721.20`. Text added by newer app versions shows up in
  English until the module catches up.

### Troubleshooting

**Still in English** — check that the module is enabled and the Claude scope is ticked,
then **force-stop** Claude and reopen it (going back to the launcher is not enough).

**Some English after updating Claude** — the newly added text is not translated yet;
everything else keeps working.

**Install fails with a signature conflict** — a module with the same package name from
another source is already installed; uninstall it first.

### Downloads

The module ships as a prebuilt APK through this repository's
[Releases](../../releases) only. Each release lists the APK checksum in its notes, and the
signing certificate fingerprint is always `896153DB…34EDD64F` — a package signed with
anything else did not come from this project.
